newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen Central Bank decided to reduce interests on deposits by five percent.
- Jordanian transportation minister says Jordan will start to export cement and oil to self-controlled areas in Palestine next month.
- Saudi Prince al-Waleed bin Talal to buy Hotel George V in Paris for $172 million.
